summary: Spark to Space is a prototype simulation game designed to recreate space missions, from Earth's surface to outer space. The game incorporates realistic space exploration concepts and adapts them into simple, accessible, and easy-to-understand gameplay mechanics. It is designed for players of all ages, regardless of their prior knowledge of space exploration or the resources required for space missions.
details:
Project Detail

The main objective of the game is to teach players how to manage essential resources required to complete various missions, such as fuel, transportation equipment, and tools for sample collection and exploration.

Throughout the gameplay, players are provided with simple and easy-to-understand explanations to help them understand the objectives and requirements of each mission. The game also challenges players' analytical and problem-solving skills by presenting different situations that require them to make decisions.

Additionally, the game incorporates puzzle-solving mechanics into each mission. These puzzles are designed to be accessible and not overly difficult, while offering different challenges and gameplay experiences throughout the game.

Benefits of the Project 

The significance of this project is to provide players with an opportunity to learn about resource management, critical thinking, and decision-making through interactive gameplay.

The game aims to enhance players' understanding of how their decisions can lead to different benefits, consequences, and potential risks. It also encourages players to consider the importance of using resources efficiently and making appropriate decisions to successfully complete their missions.

Expected Outcomes 

The expected outcomes of this project are as follows:

  • Encourage players to interact with various in-game items and participate in different missions.
  • Help players understand how to manage and allocate essential resources appropriately for each mission.
  • Provide an enjoyable and engaging learning experience that is accessible to everyone, regardless of age or gender.

Development Tools and Technologies 

Hardware:

  • Laptops owned and used by each team member.

Software:

  • Visual Studio Code (VS Code)

Coding and Development Assistance Tools:

  • OpenCode
  • Claude Code

Programming Languages and Technologies:

  • Python
  • JavaScript
  • CSS
